sections.kicker: Prepared for Contemplate by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new client would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Contemplate's strength is two founders from two crafts. Neither the site nor Instagram says so.
sections.keep: Your Instagram highlight names, "Contemplations" and "On site". They already show a point of view on hospitality.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The two founders appear as two tags at the end.
pins.why: The pairing of an interior architect and a food designer is the reason to pick you, and it reads as a footnote.
pins.how: Say who you are and what the two crafts make together, in the first line.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Clients book a design studio, not the rare pair you are.

pins.quote: shaping places , drawing spaces , curating atmospheres
pins.what: The site sentence lists verbs any studio could claim.
pins.why: Shaping, drawing and curating describe many studios; food, sound and space together describe only you.
pins.how: Rewrite this line around the full sensory scope you offer.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Your widest offer is sold as the narrowest one.

pins.what: The service list leaves out food and sound.
pins.why: Those are the services no interior studio next door can offer.
pins.how: Name food design and sound in the service line.
pins.label: Your services
pins.cost: Prospects never learn the work only you can do.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Contemplate, and you said people find it a pity that your pairing of profiles does not show. I agree, and it is the first finding below.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Contemplate's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Studio KO, from architecture. Two founders, one signature, and every project shows both minds at work.
